blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Toledo Xignex Trojans absorbed an upset 8.5–12.5 loss to the Isabela Knights of Alexander but bounced back with a dominant 17–4 rout of the IIEE-PSME Quezon City Simba’s Tribe in the ongoing Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup. Against Isabela, the Trojans struggled in both the blitz and rapid rounds, scoring only 2.5 points in blitz against their opponents’ 4.5 before dropping the rapid round, 6–8. Grandmaster (GM) Rogelio Barcenilla Jr. and International Master (IM) Barlo Nadera were Toledo’s only winners in the blitz round, beating Gerardo Cabellon and Anwar Cagubatan on […]...
